shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin and Ethereum saw a modest price rebound, but underlying funding rates still indicate bearish sentiment among traders.
The Crypto Fear & Greed Index remains deep in "Extreme Fear" territory, reflecting continued caution among investors.
Geopolitical tensions regarding US-Iran and the Strait of Hormuz are causing volatility in global markets, influencing oil prices and inflation.
A hawkish Federal Reserve outlook for "higher for longer" interest rates and continued net outflows from Bitcoin and Ethereum spot ETFs are pressuring crypto markets.
